items.title: 2.3 Electronic configuration ke experimental saboot (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.3, printed page 25.

blocks.text: Atom ke electronic structure (electrons ki tarteeb) ki aaj ki theory (nazariya) Bohr Model se shuru hui. Is model aur baad ke models ke evidence (saboot) zyada tar do cheezon se aate hain: atomic spectra aur ionization energies. Agle do topics in dono ko bari bari dekhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Electronic structure ke model ke liye do alag qism ke experiments (tajurbe) kyun faidemand hain?
blocks.explanation: Atomic spectra dikhate hain ke electrons fixed energy levels mein rehte hain, kyun ke sirf kuch khaas wavelengths nikalti ya absorb (jazb) hoti hain. Ionization energies naapti hain ke har electron kitni mazbooti se pakra hua hai, aur yun shells nazar aate hain. Dono ek doosre ko confirm (tasdeeq) karte hain.

items: Electronic structure ki theory Bohr model se shuru hoti hai; evidence atomic spectra aur ionization energies se aata hai.
